title: 第一卷 第29章 坐收渔利，暗捡遗宝
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
制服两名寻衅弟子后，苏玄尘并未停留半分。

    任由二人瘫坐在乱石之间满心悔恨，他抬步稳步走向幽谷中央。

    此刻的秘境核心，依旧喧嚣不止。

    灵力碰撞的轰鸣，此起彼伏，久久不散。

    林辰与另外三名半步筑基的顶尖天才，各占一方区域。

    四人相互制衡，彼此牵制。

    整片核心最好的高阶资源，几乎被四人牢牢垄断。

    高阶灵草、上古碎玉、秘境灵泉，尽数落入四大天骄的争夺范围。

    其余普通弟子，只能在外围游走。

    捡取一些微不足道的零碎资源，不敢越雷池半步。

    一旦靠近核心战场，轻则被驱逐，重则当场重伤。

    弱肉强食的规则，在这片幽谷展现得淋漓尽致。

    苏玄尘始终收敛全身气息。

    将修为稳稳压制在炼气三层表象，丝毫不出风头。

    他混在人群边缘，不争不抢，安静观望中心战局。

    真正的凡人流修士，从不贪图一时争锋。

    硬碰硬换来的机缘，往往伴随着巨大损耗与仇家。

    静待时机、坐收渔利，才是底层修士最稳妥的生存之道。

    谷地中央，大战仍在持续。

    四大天才为争夺一株成熟的凝霞灵草，厮杀得愈发凶狠。

    术法纵横交错，灵力狂暴四溢。

    四周低矮草木尽数被余波震碎，地面坑洼密布，碎石飞溅不休。

    四人皆是炼气九层巅峰，底蕴深厚。

    全力厮杀之下，谁也不肯退让半步。
content_en:
After subduing the two provocative disciples, Su Xuanchen did not stop for a moment.

    Letting the two of them sit paralyzed among the rocks, filled with regret, he walked steadily toward the center of the valley.

    At this moment, the core of the secret realm is still noisy.

    The roars of the collision of spiritual powers came and went one after another and lingered for a long time.

    Lin Chen and the other three top geniuses who had half-stepped the foundation, each occupied an area.

    The four of them check and balance each other.

    The best high-end resources in the entire core are almost firmly monopolized by four people.

    High-grade spiritual grass, ancient broken jade, and secret spiritual springs are all within the scope of competition among the four geniuses.

    The rest of the ordinary disciples can only wander around the periphery.

    Pick up some trivial and fragmented resources, and don't dare to go beyond the boundaries.

    Once they get close to the core battlefield, they may be expelled or seriously injured on the spot.

    The law of the jungle is clearly demonstrated in this valley.

    Su Xuanchen always restrained his aura.

    Suppressing the cultivation level firmly on the surface of the third level of Qi Refining without being in the limelight at all.

    He blended in at the edge of the crowd, quietly watching the battle unfold in the center without fighting or grabbing.

    A true mortal monk never wants to compete for a moment.

    Opportunities gained through head-to-head confrontation are often accompanied by huge losses and enemies.

    Waiting for the opportunity and reaping the benefits is the surest way for low-level monks to survive.

    In the center of the valley, the battle continued.

    The four geniuses fought for a mature Ningxia Spirit Grass, and the fight became more and more fierce.

    The spells are criss-crossing, and the spiritual power is violently overflowing.

    All the low grass and trees around were shattered by the aftermath, the ground was filled with potholes, and gravel was flying endlessly.

    All four of them are at the peak of the ninth level of Qi refining and have profound knowledge.

    While fighting with all their strength, no one would give in even a single step.
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 29: Reap the profits and secretly pick up the treasures
